title: Scanning a suffix of the input
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with no work tapes, let $q$ be a state, and suppose that in state $q$ each input bit is copied to the output while the input head moves right and the state remains $q$, and a blank input symbol causes the machine to emit nothing and halt. If Boolean words $x$, $\mathrm{pre}$, and $\mathrm{rest}$ satisfy $x=\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{rest}$, then for every output word $o$, after $|\mathrm{rest}|+1$ steps from the scan configuration on $x$ at position $|\mathrm{pre}|$ in state $q$ with output $o$, the machine is halted at position $|x|$ with output $o$ followed by $\mathrm{rest}$.
hypotheses_covered: For every input and work-tape reading, the transition in state $q$ has the specified behavior
